scripts.dev: cross-env NODE_ENV=development MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true npm run db:migrate && cross-env NODE_ENV=development MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node src/server.js
scripts.dev:local: cross-env NODE_ENV=local MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true npm run db:migrate && cross-env NODE_ENV=local MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node src/server.js
scripts.dev:production: cross-env NODE_ENV=production MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true npm run db:migrate && cross-env NODE_ENV=production MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node src/server.js
scripts.dev:watch: cross-env NODE_ENV=development MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true npm run db:migrate && cross-env NODE_ENV=development MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node --watch src/server.js
scripts.run:local: cross-env NODE_ENV=local MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node src/server.js
scripts.run:development: cross-env NODE_ENV=development MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node src/server.js
scripts.run:production: cross-env NODE_ENV=production MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node src/server.js
scripts.start:all: cross-env NODE_ENV=production MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true npm run db:migrate && cross-env NODE_ENV=production MONGODB_USE_REMOTE=true MONGODB_USE_ATLAS=true node src/server.js

scriptDescriptions.build: Checks JavaScript syntax for all project files except ignored folders.
scriptDescriptions.build:all: Runs full build validation: JavaScript syntax check plus MongoDB config validation.
scriptDescriptions.db:migrate: Creates MongoDB indexes for the active environment database.
scriptDescriptions.dev: Runs development migration, then starts the app/API/panel server without watch mode.
scriptDescriptions.dev:local: Runs local migration, then starts the app/API/panel server with NODE_ENV=local.
scriptDescriptions.dev:production: Runs production migration, then starts the app/API/panel server with NODE_ENV=production.
scriptDescriptions.dev:watch: Runs development migration, then starts the app/API/panel server with Node watch mode.
scriptDescriptions.dev:services: Alias for dev; starts all local services served by this single Node process.
scriptDescriptions.all:dev: Alias for dev:services; one command for local development.
scriptDescriptions.all:build: Alias for build:all; one command for full build validation.
scriptDescriptions.start: Starts the server with the current environment without running migrations.
scriptDescriptions.run:*: Starts the server without migration using the selected env: local, development, or production.
scriptDescriptions.start:all: Runs production migration, then starts the production app/API/panel server.
